"""Voice router factory providing audio transcription endpoints."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
from typing import Literal
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

    language: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Detected or specified language code.")
    source: Literal["groq", "mock_fallback"] = Field(..., description="Engine providing transcription.")

def build_voice_router(settings: Settings) -> APIRouter:
    router = APIRouter(prefix="/voice", tags=["Voice"])

        "/transcribe",
        response_model=VoiceTranscribeResponse,
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
        summary="Transcribe Voice Audio",
        description="Transcribes audio files using Groq Whisper large-v3-turbo, falling back to mock processor when unconfigured or in tests.",
    )
    async def transcribe_audio(
        file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Audio file payload (webm, wav, mp3, m4a, ogg)."),
        prompt: str | None = Form(default=None, description="Optional prompt context."),
        language: str | None = Form(default=None, description="ISO-639-1 language code."),
        user: UserDTO = Depends(get_current_user),
    ) -> VoiceTranscribeResponse:

        api_key = REDACTED, "GROQ_API_KEY", "") or ""

                    files = {"file": (file.filename or "audio.webm", content, file.content_type or "audio/webm")}
                    data = {"model": "whisper-large-v3-turbo"}
                    if prompt:
                        data["prompt"] = prompt
                    if language:
                        data["language"] = language

                    res = await client.post(
                        f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/audio/transcriptions",
                        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
                        files=files,
                        data=data,
                    )
                    if res.status_code == 200:
                        payload = res.json()
                        return VoiceTranscribeResponse(
                            text=payload.get("text", "").strip(),
                            language=language or payload.get("language"),
                            source="groq",
                        )
            except Exception:

        # Fallback Mock Processor

        return VoiceTranscribeResponse(
